You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
ubangiji allah kakawo mana karshen wannan fitina data addabi yankina arewa albarkacin dan gatan k fiyayyan halitta annabi muhammad rasulullah sallallahu alaihi wasallam astaghfirullah

output.original_text: ubangiji allah kakawo mana karshen wannan fitina data addabi yankina arewa albarkacin dan gatan k fiyayyan halitta annabi muhammad rasulullah sallallahu alaihi wasallam astaghfirullah
output.joy: Ubangiji Allah, ka kawo mana karshen wannan fitina da ta addabi yankinmu na arewa, albarkacin dan gatan k, fiyayyan halitta, Annabi Muhammad Rasulullah sallallahu alaihi wasallam! Astaghfirullah!
output.sadness: Ubangiji Allah, ka kawo mana karshen wannan fitina da ta addabi yankinmu na arewa. Wannan hali yana ci gaba da bayyana alherinmu, albarkacin dan gatan k, fiyayyan halitta Annabi Muhammad Rasulullah sallallahu alaihi wasallam. Astaghfirullah.
output.fear: Ubangiji Allah, ka kawo mana karshen wannan fitina da ta addabi yankinmu na arewa, domin ina jin tsoron abin da zai faru, albarkacin dan gatan k, fiyayyan halitta Annabi Muhammad Rasulullah sallallahu alaihi wasallam. Astaghfirullah.
output.anger: Ubangiji Allah, ka kawo mana karshen wannan fitina da ta addabi yankinmu na arewa! Wannan ba abin da za mu yarda da shi ba, albarkacin dan gatan k, fiyayyan halitta Annabi Muhammad Rasulullah sallallahu alaihi wasallam! Astaghfirullah!
output.surprise: Ubangiji Allah, ka kawo mana karshen wannan fitina da ta addabi yankinmu na arewa? Wai, wannan abin ya ja hankali, albarkacin dan gatan k, fiyayyan halitta Annabi Muhammad Rasulullah sallallahu alaihi wasallam! Astaghfirullah.
output.disgust: Ubangiji Allah, ka kawo mana karshen wannan fitina da ta addabi yankinmu na arewa, domin wannan yana jawo munanan lamura, albarkacin dan gatan k, fiyayyan halitta Annabi Muhammad Rasulullah sallallahu alaihi wasallam! Astaghfirullah.
